title: Account Seasoning Addition - Credit Builder Accounts Early-Closure Late-Fee Relief
content:
The relief share of the early-closure late-fee relief on a Credit Builder account grows with how long the account has been open and how many payments it has had credited.

## Seasoning tiers

An account open 12 months or more with 12 or more payments credited (payments posted to the account less payments returned on it) adds the seasoned addition; one open at least 6 months with at least 6 payments credited, but either open fewer than 12 months or with fewer than 12 credited, adds the established addition; any other account adds nothing for seasoning; months open are whole calendar months from the open date, each complete on the day of the month matching the opening day or, in a month too short for that day, on the first day of the following month.

Payments credited are the number of the account's payment entries less the number of its returned-payment entries. The open date is the date the account activated.

| Months open | Payments credited | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | 12 or more | seasoned addition: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| 12 or more | 6 to 11 | established addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| 6 to 11 | 6 or more | established addition: 0.05 |
| fewer than 6 | any | nothing |
| any | fewer than 6 | nothing |

## Example (hypothetical account)

An account opened 31 August has, on 28 February of the next year, 5 whole months open, and on 1 March 6. An account with 14 payment entries of which 3 were returned has 11 payments credited: open 20 months, it takes the established addition.
